items.title: James Moody — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was married to a lady by the name of Margina and she wanted to move to California because that's where I met her.

ctx.x: So let's talk a little bit about your years in Las Vegas. Could you tell me, first of all, when you -- when you left Dizzy and made the decision that you were going to do something else, did you leave and do something else right away or was there a time when you kinda were trying to decide what you wanted to do and this opportunity came up?
Well, first of all, I was married -- I was married to a lady by the name of Margina and she wanted to move to California because that's where I met her.
Right. Now, this is not the lady from France -­
